dsl.missing: Every comparison with missing fails, including neq; only explicit exists/not exists may inspect absence. null is distinct from missing. mapGet/findBy returns null for no match.
dsl.filter: Lexical item names only. A failed/missing predicate excludes item. Side effects forbidden.
dsl.project: Dot path inside a declared returned object only; arbitrary reflection or eval forbidden.
dsl.every: All items satisfy; call site must separately require nonempty when needed.
dsl.ordering: codepoint except engine successor order explicitly retains localeCompare
dsl.unsupportedSelectors: Unresolved specification names only; not runtime implementation availability. All derived adapters remain not_installed; enabledInEngine=false remains mandatory.
dsl.bindingMissing: query.missing=invalidate invalidates its declared scope. requiredForChoices explicitly overrides entry default and disables only listed choices; absent marker blocks entry. Required bindings must not depend on choice-only bindings. Recount minimumEnabledConsequentialChoices after all disabled/no-op choices.

executionContext.resolvedCommandArgs.source: current choice.commands[0].args after recursively resolving declared binding tokens once; preserve same bound IDs
executionContext.resolvedCommandArgs.phase: after instance bindings, before choice eligibility and dispatch
